meta.title: Sadeed Studio: Immersive Learning
meta.description: Sadeed Studio is an Amman-based studio building VR experiences, XR/AR learning apps, educational games and training simulations for schools, universities, government and enterprise.
meta.contactDescription: Talk to Sadeed Studio about VR, XR/AR, educational games or training simulations for your institution. Request a demo today.

hero.description: We design and build immersive educational experiences that help students understand faster, trainees practise safely, and institutions measure real progress.
hero.trust: Built for schools, universities and training centres across Jordan and the region
hero.visualAlt: Abstract low-poly illustration of a VR headset

about.title: An immersive learning studio from Amman
about.body1: Sadeed Studio is a team of educators, 3D artists and Unity engineers based in Amman, Jordan. We turn curricula, procedures and complex concepts into interactive experiences that learners can see, touch and explore.
about.body2: We work closely with teachers, subject-matter experts and decision-makers, so every experience is pedagogically sound, culturally relevant, fully bilingual and built to run on the hardware you already have.
about.mission: To make high-quality immersive learning accessible to every classroom and training centre in the Arab world.
about.vision: Learning outcomes first, technology second. We measure success by what learners can do afterwards.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: End-to-end immersive solutions, from the first idea to deployment in your classrooms and training rooms.

vr.title: VR Educational Experiences
vr.description: Fully immersive virtual labs, field trips and lessons for standalone headsets like Meta Quest and Pico.

xr.title: XR / AR Learning Apps
xr.description: Augmented reality apps that bring textbooks, models and equipment to life on phones and tablets.

games.title: Educational Games
games.description: Game-based learning for web and mobile that turns practice into play, with progress tracking built in.

simulations.title: Training Simulations
simulations.description: Realistic medical, technical and safety simulations so trainees can practise high-risk procedures without the risk.

why.title: Learning by doing, not just watching
why.subtitle: Immersive learning puts students inside the lesson. That changes how much they remember and how ready they feel.

retention.label: Faster to train
retention.description: Learners complete hands-on modules faster than with classroom instruction alone.

engagement.label: More confident
engagement.description: Learners feel more confident applying what they practised in a realistic environment.

safe.label: Real-world risk
safe.description: Practise dangerous or expensive procedures as often as needed, with no harm to people or equipment.

focus.label: More focused
focus.description: Headsets remove distractions, so learners stay on task far longer than on a laptop screen.

why.note: Figures from PwC, "The Effectiveness of Virtual Reality Soft Skills Training in the Enterprise" (2020), compared with classroom learners. Results vary by context and program design.

process.title: Our process
process.subtitle: A clear, collaborative path from idea to impact.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: We meet your educators and experts to define learning outcomes, audience, hardware and success metrics.

design.title: Design
design.description: Storyboards, interaction design and prototypes, reviewed with you before a single line of production code.

develop.title: Develop (Unity)
develop.description: We build in Unity with 3D art, Arabic and English content, and regular playable builds for your feedback.

deploy.title: Deploy & Support
deploy.description: Installation, teacher training, analytics and ongoing updates so the experience keeps delivering value.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
